judgeModel.label: Judge Model
judgeModel.help: Model used by the LLM judge to score rubric criteria. Default: gpt-4o-mini.

defaultResponder.label: Default Responder
defaultResponder.help: Which responder the CLI builds when --responder is omitted: command | openai.

model.label: OpenAI Responder Model
model.help: Model for the openai responder (the system under test). Default: gpt-4o-mini.

apiKeyEnv.label: API Key Env Var
apiKeyEnv.help: Environment variable holding the OpenAI API key for judge + openai responder. Default: OPENAI_API_KEY.

passThreshold.label: Judge Pass Threshold
passThreshold.help: Default minimum judge score (0..1) for a criteria-based case to pass. Default: 0.6.
